key-audit.name: Key Audit
key-audit.description: Who holds what from their log. No alarm codes, lockbox pins, or passwords.

license-watch.name: License Watch
license-watch.description: Expire dates from their tracker or certificate images. Flag past or blank.

mail-log.name: Mail Log
mail-log.description: What arrived. Checks seen only — they deposit; you never endorse or move funds.

meeting-pack.name: Meeting Pack
meeting-pack.description: Agenda plus open actions from last minutes.

recurring-checklist.name: Recurring Checklist
recurring-checklist.description: Only lines they named. Missing owner: ask in the write-up, do not assign.

retention-boxes.name: Retention Boxes
retention-boxes.description: Label and hold flag from their sheet. Do not shred, haul, or invent retention years.

supplies.name: Supplies
supplies.description: Build or update a supply CSV for them to order. Flag at or below their min.

vendor-contacts.name: Vendor Contacts
vendor-contacts.description: Contacts and renewal months from their file. Do not invent phones, account numbers, or a website listing as their account.

visitor-week.name: Visitor Week
visitor-week.description: If they use a visitor sheet, list the week they named. No ID numbers, license photos, or badge data in the pack.

weekly-pack.name: Weekly Pack
weekly-pack.description: From their task sheet and calendar export, list this week's items and missing files.
